title: Apple says more ex-employees may have taken confidential data to OpenAI
summary: Apple's investigation into alleged trade secret theft by OpenAI has expanded, with the company claiming additional former employees may have retained or accessed confidential information. This widens an already contentious legal dispute between the tech giants over employee departures.
content: Apple says its trade secrets investigation into OpenAI has widened. In a new court filing, Apple claims additional former staff may have retained or accessed confidential information.

zh.title: 苹果称更多前员工可能将机密数据转交给OpenAI
zh.summary: 苹果对OpenAI涉嫌盗取商业机密的调查已经扩大,该公司声称更多前员工可能保留或访问了机密信息。这加剧了这两个科技巨头之间因员工离职而引发的法律纠纷。

title: Spotify now has over 300M subscribers
summary: Spotify reached a milestone of over 300 million subscribers, growing 9% in Q2 despite price increases across multiple regions. The company's expanding user base demonstrates strong demand for music streaming despite economic pressures.
content: Notably, the company saw its subscriber base swell by 9% in the second quarter despite raising prices in several regions this year.

zh.title: Spotify现在拥有超过3亿用户
zh.summary: Spotify达到了超过3亿用户的里程碑,尽管在多个地区提高了价格,但在第二季度仍增长了9%。该公司不断扩大的用户基础表明,尽管经济压力巨大,音乐流媒体仍有强劲需求。

title: India moves to give its instant payments network a business model
summary: India is considering legislation to reform its UPI instant payments system by introducing merchant fees to replace its zero-discount-rate policy in place since 2020. The change aims to create a sustainable business model for India's digital payments infrastructure.
content: The legislation lays the groundwork for a potential overhaul of India's zero-merchant-discount-rate regime, under which businesses have not paid fees to accept UPI payments since 2020.

zh.title: 印度计划为其即时支付网络引入商业模式
zh.summary: 印度正在考虑立法改革其UPI即时支付系统,通过引入商户费用来取代自2020年以来实施的零贴现率政策。这一变化旨在为印度的数字支付基础设施创建可持续的商业模式。

title: Is the future of data centers portable? Runware builds a pod to find out
summary: AI infrastructure company Runware announced the launch of Sonic Inference Pod, a modular data center designed to explore portable computing infrastructure for AI workloads. The innovation addresses scalability and accessibility challenges in distributed compute.
content: On Tuesday, AI infrastructure company Runware announced the launch of its own modular data center called Sonic Inference Pod.

zh.title: 数据中心的未来会是便携式的吗?Runware推出Pod来寻找答案
zh.summary: AI基础设施公司Runware宣布推出Sonic Inference Pod，这是一款为探索AI工作负载便携式计算基础设施而设计的模块化数据中心。该创新解决了分布式计算中的可扩展性和可访问性挑战。

title: Peak Design’s latest bags have clever integrated hooks
summary: Peak Design launched its City Line collection of lightweight bags featuring an innovative BagLev hook that tucks into pockets to suspend bags from tables and chairs. The six bags, available in multiple colors and sizes, launch today.
content:
Peak Design’s BagLev hook tucks away inside a pocket when not in use. | Image: Peak Design	

Peak Design's new City Line collection includes six lightweight bags designed for everyday carry. There's a 15-liter and 22L City Backpack, 15L City Tote, 6L and 12L City Crescent crossbody bags, and 2L City Sling. All are available starting today and feature a new BagLev hook that can suspend the bags from a table ledge or chair to keep them free of cafe sludge and park filth. 
The bags are available in a variety of colors - I'm a a fan of the natural "Moon" (whiteish) color, which will benefit from the BagLev hook. The vibrant "Lapis" blue color is definitely a choice.
"Rather than adding more features, Peak Design refined every material …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: Peak Design最新包包配备了巧妙的集成挂钩
zh.summary: Peak Design推出了City Line轻包系列，配备创新的BagLev挂钩，可以折叠进口袋中，用于将包挂在桌子和椅子上。这六款包有多种颜色和尺寸可选，今天上市。

title: Nothing CMF is launching its first open earbuds
summary: Nothing's budget sub-brand CMF introduced the CMF Clip Pro, open-design earbuds priced at $99 that prioritize situational awareness over sound isolation. The earbuds come in three color options and launch today in the US.
content:
You get three color options to choose from, each with a coordinating charging case. | Image: Nothing	

Open earbuds are having a bit of a moment right now, and Nothing is the latest company jumping on the trend. Its budget sub-brand has introduced the CMF Clip Pro, CMF's first open earbuds that are designed to provide comfort and sound quality for people who don't want to sacrifice their situational awareness.
The $99 CMF Clip Pro is available starting today in the US, and comes in three color variations: white, black, and orange (which are described as light gray, dark gray, and coral, respectively). That's the same price as Nothing's Ear 3A and original Ear (a) buds, so you're not paying an additional premium for an intriguing design here. …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: Nothing CMF推出首款开放式耳塞
zh.summary: Nothing的平价子品牌CMF推出了CMF Clip Pro，这是一款开放设计的耳塞，售价99美元，优先考虑情景意识而不是隔音。这款耳塞有三种颜色可选，今天在美国上市。

title: Apple briefly yanked Telegram from the App Store over CSAM violations
summary: Apple removed Telegram from the App Store over concerns about child sexual abuse material, then restored it after the developer removed the content and banned the responsible user. The incident highlights Apple's strict CSAM enforcement but raises questions about consistent application across all apps.
content:
Telegram is back on the App Store after Apple briefly removed it on Monday night over concerns about child sexual abuse material (CSAM). In a statement to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, Apple says a review found that Telegram "violates our strict guidelines prohibiting child sexual abuse material," adding that it restored the app "after the developer promptly removed the content and banned the user who posted it."
Telegram responded to Apple's statement in a post on X, saying: "I'm sure this stance will be applied equally to all other apps in the store, in the future, ​right?" Telegram also includes a link to its safety overview page, which says  …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: Apple因CSAM违规问题暂时从App Store下架Telegram
zh.summary: Apple因担忧儿童性虐待材料而将Telegram从App Store下架，开发者移除相关内容并封禁违规用户后应用被恢复。该事件突显了Apple严格的CSAM执法态度，但也引发了对其在所有应用中是否一致执法的疑问。

title: EON wants to move the data superhighway from ocean fiber to space lasers
summary: Endeavour Optical Networks plans to launch the fastest space laser communications system yet built to replace traditional ocean-based fiber optic networks. The shift could fundamentally reshape global data infrastructure deployment and redundancy.
content: Endeavour Optical Networks is planning to launch the fastest space laser communications system yet built.

zh.title: EON欲将数据超级通道从海底光纤转向空间激光
zh.summary: Endeavour Optical Networks计划推出迄今最快的空间激光通信系统，以取代传统的海底光纤网络。这一转变可能从根本上重塑全球数据基础设施的部署和冗余方式。

title: Bending Spoons to buy Airtable for $1.28B
summary: Software company Bending Spoons is acquiring Airtable for $1.28 billion, a steep discount from the no-code platform's $11 billion peak valuation in 2021. The acquisition reflects challenging market conditions, with Airtable's secondary market shares valued at $4 billion earlier this year.
content: At its peak in 2021, Airtable was valued at over $11 billion, but earlier this year, its shares were said to be trading on the secondary markets at a valuation of $4 billion.

zh.title: Bending Spoons以12.8亿美元收购Airtable
zh.summary: 软件公司Bending Spoons以12.8亿美元收购无代码平台Airtable，这较其2021年110亿美元的峰值估值有大幅下滑。该收购反映了严峻的市场形势，Airtable的二级市场股份今年早些时候估值仅为40亿美元。

title: OpenAI drags Apple’s lawsuit into the court of public opinion
summary: OpenAI publicly countered Apple's trade secret theft lawsuit with a blog post and leaked communications, arguing Apple's claims are "careless, aggressive, and oddly personal." The move represents an unusual escalation, as OpenAI attempts to sway public opinion alongside its legal defense.
content:
OpenAI says Apple’s lawsuit is “careless, aggressive, and oddly personal.” | Image: Cath Virginia / The Verge, Getty Images	

Apple's legal battle against OpenAI just got messier now that the ChatGPT-maker has publicly aired receipts to counter Apple's version of events. In a blog post published overnight titled "Apple is getting this wrong," OpenAI said that Apple's lawsuit accusing it of stealing trade secrets is "careless, aggressive, and oddly personal," sharing iMessage and email exchanges to challenge allegations central to the case.
This isn't a legal response from OpenAI, but it's an attempt to sway the court of public opinion by poking contradictions into Apple's case using cherry-picked communications.
The lawsuit filed by Apple last month primarily rev …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: OpenAI将苹果诉讼诉诸舆论
zh.summary: OpenAI通过发表博客文章和泄露通讯公开反驳苹果关于商业机密被盗的诉讼,声称苹果的指控"草率、咄咄逼人且非常个人化"。这一举动代表了一次不寻常的升级,OpenAI试图同时在法庭和舆论上为自己辩护。

title: The next Xbox could play every Xbox game ever made
summary: A leaked memo reveals Microsoft's Project Helix console will support backward compatibility across all Xbox generations—from the original 2001 Xbox through Xbox Series—plus PC games and new titles. The innovation would give the next Xbox the largest library of any home console.
content:
The next Xbox, Project Helix, could theoretically have the largest library of any home console. Not only will it play PC games, but we now know, courtesy of a leaked memo obtained by The Verge's Tom Warren, that it will run games from every generation of Xbox: the original 2001 Xbox, the 2005 Xbox 360, the 2013 Xbox One, and the 2020 Xbox Series, as well as any new Helix titles.
We already knew that Microsoft was bringing a limited sample of original Xbox games to PC, and we already knew it was prepping a way to digitize your Xbox One and Xbox Series discs. The leak fills in the missing puzzle pieces. 
Microsoft is bringing Xbox 360 games  …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 下一代Xbox可能支持运行所有Xbox游戏
zh.summary: 一份泄露的备忘录显示,微软的Project Helix主机将支持所有Xbox代系的向后兼容性——从2001年的初代Xbox到Xbox Series——以及PC游戏和新游戏。这项创新将让下一代Xbox拥有任何家用主机中最大的游戏库。

title: Can Reddit fend off a new wave of AI SEO spam?
summary: Reddit faces a surge of AI-generated SEO spam disguised as authentic user comments, with bot accounts promoting products through seemingly genuine reviews. The trend challenges Reddit's community authenticity and raises questions about the platform's ability to combat automated manipulation.
content:
Earlier this year, a Reddit user had asked members of a skincare-focused subreddit if anyone had tried a specific hypochlorous acid spray, a product often used for acne. There were dozens of responses; one from a user named Primary-Taro4254 seemed innocuous enough, at least at first.
"I haven't personally tried [that brand] so I can't fully compare, sorry," they commented. "But I have been using a similar hypochlorous acid spray from Honeydew Labs and I've honestly really liked it." 
Primary-Taro4254 helpfully shared their experience using the spray to calm their skin's redness and irritation, and even threw in some of Honeydew Labs' crede …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: Reddit能否抵挡新一波AI SEO垃圾信息?
zh.summary: Reddit正面临AI生成的SEO垃圾信息激增,这些垃圾信息伪装成真实用户评论,机器人账户通过看似真实的评价推广产品。这一趋势挑战了Reddit社区的真实性,并引发了人们对该平台防止自动化操纵能力的疑问。

title: The studio behind Pokémon struggles to find its voice in Beast of Reincarnation
summary: Game Freak ventures beyond its Pokémon franchise with Beast of Reincarnation, an action game intended to showcase the studio's creative potential. However, the game lacks the innovative ideas needed to stand out in the crowded action genre. The project represents an ambitious attempt to break from the pocket monster series but ultimately falls short in execution.
content:
You have to imagine that the team at Game Freak is bursting with ideas. The studio puts out new mainline Pokémon adventures with a machinelike precision. But every so often it launches a curious experiment, whether it's an action title about a militarized elephant or turning horse races into a card game, showing that it's capable of more than the latest generation of pocket monsters. That's part of what makes the idea of Beast of Reincarnation so enticing. Here is an established studio breaking free of the franchise it has become known for to make its take on a blockbuster action game. Unfortunately new ideas are in short supply in Beast, an …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 开发精灵宝可梦的工作室在《转生之兽》中难以找到自己的声音
zh.summary: Game Freak通过《转生之兽》这款动作游戏进军精灵宝可梦系列之外，意图展示该工作室的创意潜力。然而，这款游戏缺乏在拥挤的动作游戏类型中脱颖而出所需的创新理念。该项目代表了一次雄心勃勃的尝试，试图打破口袋妖怪系列的束缚，但在执行中最终功亏一篑。
